title: AgentState
description: Minimal state contract passed between nodes in the LangGraph support agent workflow (Part 1 RAG + Part 2 Real-Time Operational Tools).

top_k.description: Maximum number of chunks to retrieve.

selected_sources.description: Ordered list of planned data sources selected autonomously at intake (canonical sequence: ticket_tool -> inventory_tool -> rag).

sources_consulted.description: Chronological list of data sources consulted during workflow execution.

ticket_tool_output.description: Typed response from SupportTicketToolPort (capped at 20 records + total_matched).

inventory_tool_output.description: Typed response from InventoryStockToolPort (capped at 20 records + total_matched).

contexts.description: List of retrieved knowledge chunks qualifying under min_score.

fallback_triggered.description: True when an operational tool timed out, encountered an error, or returned not_found and traversed tool_fallback.

fallback_messages.description: Honest inability-to-confirm notices recorded by tool_fallback_node.

answer.description: Final synthesized answer, hybrid partial answer, honest tool fallback message, or standardized refusal.

is_refusal.description: Indicates whether the answer is an honest refusal due to empty input, write-mutation attempt, or out-of-scope policy query.

sources.description: List of cited static policy sources for the response.

step_latencies.description: Latency in milliseconds for each visited node.

node_outputs.description: Structured output payload produced by each visited node.

error.description: Sanitized error message if a failure occurred during node execution.
